would like jot down my experiences in the medicine department.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe first day as an intern was a blend of excitement with nervous anticipation. Stepping into the clinical realm as a healthcare professional was a mixture of pride and humility. The responsibility is tangible, and the transition from student to practitioner was palpable. I have joined it with eagerness to apply theoretical knowledge to real-life situations, coupled with the awareness that decisions now directly impact patient well-being. Long shifts, patient interactions, and challenging cases have become part of daily life, fostering resilience and sharpening clinical skills. Life has become a delicate balance between learning, responsibility, and the emotional weight of healthcare decisions.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELearning and unlearning things was indeed a complex task .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is an online e-log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardian's signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients' problems through a series of inputs from the available global online community of experts to solve those patients' clinical problems with collective current best evidence-based information.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable input in the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHere I would like to reflect on a case that I have seen during my 3 rd prof medicine postings\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/manisharanga132.blogspot.com\/2022\/10\/33-year-old-female-with.html\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/manisharanga132.blogspot.com\/2022\/10\/33-year-old-female-with.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003EPajr\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/chat.whatsapp.com\/IVsV2JINwLSAjzTO8A1RTL\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/chat.whatsapp.com\/IVsV2JINwLSAjzTO8A1RTL\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003ELink to my presentation :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/youtu.be\/Wenz2E9GS-I?si=52tcQKKW0xlQIRRJ\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/youtu.be\/Wenz2E9GS-I?si=52tcQKKW0xlQIRRJ\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; Vasodilatory edema in this study was associated with the presence of other comorbidities, amlodipine dose, and duration, while age, gender, type of amlodipine, and concurrent use of ACEIs\/ARBs were not associated. With comorbidities, longer duration, and a higher dose of amlodipine, likelihood of pedal edema goes up. This article adds the prevalence of pedal edema in hypertensive individuals under amlodipine and relation between pedal edema and other Ascites was managed by therapeutic tapping.( around 8 litres of ascites fluid was tapped)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince 15 days,he developed bilateral scrotal edema , gradually progressive associated with dragging type of pain , local rise of temperature and redness present.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of fever associated with productive cough\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-No H\/o hematemesis , bleeding per rectum, constipation.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-No history of orthopnoea, paroxysmal nocturnal
